description: This Java class 'Link' extends Android's Activity class and demonstrates various ways to create and display clickable links in TextView widgets, including autoLink property, HTML-formatted strings, and manually styled SpannableStrings.

classes.name: Link
classes.description: An Android Activity that demonstrates different methods of creating and handling links within TextViews.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and configures multiple TextViews with different link styles and behaviors.
